knowledge.name: Fixed synthetic fraud operating snapshot
knowledge.detail: Bundled fictional transactions, accounts, rules, risk scores, patterns, and cases provide deterministic evidence for investigation demos.

knowledge.name: Fraud controls and evidence boundaries
knowledge.detail: Packaged guidance separates observed activity, rule triggers, hypotheses, proposed review steps, human decisions, and prohibited actions.

knowledge.name: Operation skills and locked case anchors
knowledge.detail: Four skills route persona-language requests and preserve source-backed anchors for alert, account, pattern, and SIU case scenarios.

intelligence_processing.name: Explainable overnight alert triage
intelligence_processing.detail: Ranks the fictional queue by transaction risk and rule severity, then exposes the exact evidence behind urgent investigator attention.

intelligence_processing.name: Account sequence evidence analysis
intelligence_processing.detail: Summarizes amounts, merchants, countries, channels, timing, and account totals to support analyst review of suspicious sequences.

intelligence_processing.name: Fraud-pattern hypothesis comparison
intelligence_processing.detail: Compares active cases with packaged card-cloning, account-takeover, bust-out, and synthetic-identity indicators without determining fraud.

intelligence_processing.name: Investigation packet preparation
intelligence_processing.detail: Assembles case status, priority, analyst, notes, linked transactions, triggered rules, and action status for authorized investigator review.

intelligence_processing.name: Human-authorized escalation routing
intelligence_processing.detail: Proposes SIU or fraud-operations queues while leaving routing, filings, customer contact, and protective actions to authorized people.

clients_user_interface.name: Copilot Studio investigator workspace
clients_user_interface.detail: Provides a Draft agent with four operation behaviors, two synthetic knowledge files, integrated authentication, and no web search.

clients_user_interface.name: Portable Brainstem chat experience
clients_user_interface.detail: Runs the single-file FraudDetectionAlertAgent through local chat and streaming endpoints with deterministic synthetic-only tool execution.

clients_user_interface.name: Persona-focused fraud review
clients_user_interface.detail: Fraud analysts, operations managers, SIU investigators, and risk leaders receive evidence-first answers with explicit review boundaries.

management_reporting.name: Alert queue risk report
management_reporting.detail: Reports high-risk transaction count, flagged amount, open cases, risk level, merchant, country, and triggered rule severity.

management_reporting.name: Account transaction sequence view
management_reporting.detail: Presents transaction-level evidence and account totals so analysts can inspect sequences such as the two Dubai card-present purchases.

management_reporting.name: Pattern hypothesis report
management_reporting.detail: Lists known indicator definitions and active case matches while stating that a score or pattern is an investigative signal, not proof.

management_reporting.name: SIU case preparation report
management_reporting.detail: Shows case facts, evidence, proposed queue, and whether any external action occurred before authorized SIU, legal, or compliance review.

tools.name: Portable FraudDetectionAlertAgent RAPP tool
tools.detail: Single-file Python BasicAgent implements alert triage, transaction analysis, pattern detection, and investigation summaries.

tools.name: Brainstem runtime
tools.detail: Local-first RAPP server discovers the portable agent and exposes conversational chat, streaming, health, and agent endpoints.

tools.name: Microsoft Copilot Studio
tools.detail: Hosts the Draft investigator workspace, synthetic knowledge, and four behaviors; publishing remains a separate confirmed action.

tools.name: Approved transaction-monitoring data
tools.detail: Production connection seam for monitored transaction evidence; the current package uses only the fixed fictional snapshot.

tools.name: Dynamics 365 investigation cases
tools.detail: Production seam for governed fraud case context and workflow; the packaged agent does not create, update, or route a case.

tools.name: Microsoft Sentinel security signals
tools.detail: Approved seam for device, identity, and security evidence; no live Sentinel signal is connected to the synthetic package.

tools.name: Microsoft Teams SIU escalation
tools.detail: Approved collaboration seam for investigator escalation and review; the package does not send messages or request approvals.

tools.name: Authorized protective-action workflows
tools.detail: Governed seam for filings, blocks, releases, and payment actions; none can be initiated by the packaged agent.

supporting_features.name: Fixed synthetic evidence policy
supporting_features.detail: Uses only bundled fictional records and forbids browsing, enrichment, substitution, or invention of customer and fraud evidence.

supporting_features.name: Four deterministic investigation operations
supporting_features.detail: Routes alert urgency, account activity, pattern hypotheses, and named-case preparation requests to one bounded operation.

supporting_features.name: Evidence-first response contract
supporting_features.detail: Separates observed transactions, triggered rules, hypotheses, and proposed review actions while citing exact packaged identifiers.

supporting_features.name: Fail-closed identifier handling
supporting_features.detail: Rejects unknown case and account identifiers instead of substituting another fictional record or fabricating corroboration.

supporting_features.name: Fraud hypothesis boundary
supporting_features.detail: Treats scores, rule matches, and pattern indicators as investigation signals and never as proof, accusation, or fraud determination.

supporting_features.name: Investigation and escalation gate
supporting_features.detail: Requires authorized investigators, SIU, operations, legal, compliance, or filing officers to review and decide every next step.

supporting_features.name: No autonomous blocking or external action
supporting_features.detail: Prevents card, account, wire, payment, or fund blocks; releases; outreach; case actions; filings; messages; and record changes.
